algorithm.Title: Postpartum - Headache - Female (Adult)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Adult | Female
Definition: Postpartum headache assessment for a person who has given birth within the last year. Pre-eclampsia is especially relevant in the first days or weeks after birth; other pregnancy-related complications can occur later.
FirstAid: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 now. Do not drive yourself. Tell the call handler that the patient gave birth recently. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
algorithm.Author: IST Health Open-Source Guideline Content
algorithm.LastRevised: RESEARCH_REQUIRED - internal IST clinical adaptation date is not recorded

questions.Question: Is this a non-postpartum headache presentation without recent childbirth?
questions.Information: A headache not occurring in the postpartum period belongs in the Headache pathway.

questions.Question: Is there a severe headache that doesn't go away with simple painkillers, vision problems (blurred vision or flashing lights), pain below the ribs, sudden swelling of the face/hands/feet, feeling very unwell, persistent heartburn unresponsive to medication, or vomiting?
questions.Information: NHS.UK guidance lists these as pre-eclampsia warning signs that can appear in the days or weeks after birth and always need immediate evaluation.

questions.Question: Is there a new or persistent postpartum headache without the emergency features above?
questions.Information: A new or persistent headache after birth requires clinical assessment because remote questioning alone cannot exclude a hypertensive, neurological, anaesthetic-related, or infectious cause.

advice.Title: Emergency postpartum pre-eclampsia precautions
Content: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 now. Do not drive yourself. Tell the call handler that the patient gave birth recently. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: worsening headache; vision changes worsen.

advice.Title: Prompt postpartum headache review
Content: Arrange prompt clinical assessment through the locally approved Qatar maternity pathway; the exact non-emergency destination remains GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED. Seek emergency help on 999 if the headache becomes severe or vision change, fainting, seizure, breathing difficulty, chest pain, severe upper abdominal pain, or marked swelling develops.
Call Back If: headache becomes severe; vision changes or swelling develop.

references: NHS.UK, "Pre-eclampsia", https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/pre-eclampsia/ (page last reviewed 23 March 2026) - explicitly covers postpartum onset
CDC Hear Her, urgent maternal warning signs during pregnancy or within one year after pregnancy, https://www.cdc.gov/hearher/
